name: NoMaxEnchant: Customize Anvil Enchantment Level Cap
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Jahus
description:
Works with modded and vanilla enchantments.
Uncap enchantment levels on the anvil: Remove enchantment cap, configure per-enchantment cap and set a global cap for all enchantments.
Combine books above the vanilla max.
needs: Mixin: 1 point inside the game's methods
roadmap: Code next to data (0.3), Machines (0.4), Mixin (0.5)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
